column5: Variant: contemporary two-story house in an established residential neighborhood (like Chapultepec in Guadalajara or Del Valle in Monterrey), smooth painted facade with large blank wall planes, slim black window frames, a tall solid-wood front door, a cantera-stone path and a mature garden with a jacaranda tree and agaves; no car gate in front of the camera; clear morning sky. The upper-left part of the facade is a large blank painted wall.

Variant: child bedroom in a well-designed house: one bed with a solid wood frame and soft linen bedding, a small reading armchair, wooden toys and books on a low open shelf, a floor lamp, a woven rug, black window frame with linen curtain at the right. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.

Variant: well-designed bathroom: a wooden floating vanity with a light stone countertop and a vessel sink, black faucet, a round mirror on the right half of the painted wall, large-format porcelain floor, a plant, folded linen towels. The left half of the painted wall is blank.

Variant: dining room with a solid wood table for six, woven chairs, a natural-fiber pendant lamp hanging over the RIGHT side of the table, a low sideboard with a clay pot and fruit bowl. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.
